title: Connolly Norman
html_source: Conolly Norman (12 March 1853- February 1908) was an Irish alienist, or psychiatrist, of the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries. He was the Resident Medical Superintendent of a number of district asylums, most notably Ireland’s largest asylum, the Richmond District Lunatic Asylum, now known as St. Brendan’s Hospital.
